about: Role joint -> node on the 19-joint Mixamo rig (Armagedom vagrant-106: skin joints Hips, Spine, Spine2, shoulders, arms, neck, head, legs; no Spine1 skin joint, no toes). Spine1 is the pass-through node Mixamo keeps between Spine and Spine2 (in the node tree, not in the skin), so it maps to itself. The rig has no toes: ToeBase is put 0.20 m from the Foot node along the foot bone (+Y, which points down-forward to the ball of the foot), about 0.106 of the 1.89 m height (brute-106: 0.21 m on 2.09 m). Used by tools/glb-measure.mjs only. In the game the toe parts have no bone: give them an empty Object3D child of the Foot bone (see docs).
